senses.definitionEn: a qualitative change
senses.glossZh: 性质上的变化

senses.definitionEn: the time period during which you are at work
senses.glossZh: 班次；一段当班时间

senses.definitionEn: change place or direction
senses.glossZh: 移动；改变位置或方向
sourceExamples: Shift one's position

senses.definitionEn: move from one setting or context to another
senses.glossZh: 转移到另一场景或语境
sourceExamples: shift the emphasis
shift one's attention

senses.definitionEn: a concise explanation of the meaning of a word or phrase or symbol
senses.glossZh: 定义；对词语或符号意义的简要说明

senses.definitionEn: clarity of outline
senses.glossZh: 轮廓的清晰度
sourceExamples: exercise had given his muscles superior definition

senses.definitionEn: adequate for practical use; especially sufficient in strength or numbers to accomplish something
senses.glossZh: 实用的；足以用于实际工作的
sourceExamples: the party has a working majority in the House
a working knowledge of Spanish

senses.definitionEn: adopted as a temporary basis for further work
senses.glossZh: 暂定用作进一步工作基础的
sourceExamples: a working draft
a working hypothesis

senses.definitionEn: (of e.g. a machine) performing or capable of performing
senses.glossZh: 正常运转的；能工作的
sourceExamples: in running (or working) order
a functional set of brakes

senses.definitionEn: serving to permit or facilitate further work or activity
senses.glossZh: 供进一步工作或活动使用的
sourceExamples: discussed the working draft of a peace treaty
they need working agreements with their neighbor states on interstate projects

senses.definitionEn: a system of assumptions and standards that sanction behavior and give it meaning
senses.glossZh: 理解或判断事物的观念框架

senses.definitionEn: a framework that supports and protects a picture or a mirror
senses.glossZh: 画框；镜框
sourceExamples: the frame enhances but is not itself the subject of attention
the frame was much more valuable than the mirror it held

senses.definitionEn: formulation of the plans and important details
senses.glossZh: 计划及重要细节的拟定
sourceExamples: the framing of judicial decrees

senses.definitionEn: a framework that supports and protects a picture or a mirror
senses.glossZh: 画框；镜框的框架
sourceExamples: the frame enhances but is not itself the subject of attention
the frame was much more valuable than the mirror it held

senses.definitionEn: formulate in a particular style or language
senses.glossZh: 以某种方式组织、表述
sourceExamples: I wouldn't put it that way
She cast her request in very polite language

senses.definitionEn: make up plans or basic details for
senses.glossZh: 拟定计划或基本细节
sourceExamples: frame a policy

senses.definitionEn: something that results
senses.glossZh: 结果；某事产生的后果
sourceExamples: he listened for the results on the radio

senses.definitionEn: a record or narrative description of past events
senses.glossZh: 对事情的叙述、记述
sourceExamples: a history of France
he gave an inaccurate account of the plot to kill the president
the story of exposure to lead

senses.definitionEn: a formal contractual relationship established to provide for regular banking or brokerage or business services
senses.glossZh: 账户；与银行等建立的业务关系
sourceExamples: he asked to see the executive who handled his account

senses.definitionEn: allow or plan for a certain possibility; concede the truth or validity of something
senses.glossZh: 考虑到；把某种可能性或事实纳入考量
sourceExamples: I allow for this possibility
The seamstress planned for 5% shrinkage after the first wash

senses.definitionEn: furnish a justifying analysis or explanation
senses.glossZh: 作出说明或解释
sourceExamples: I can't account for the missing money

senses.definitionEn: free from danger or the risk of harm
senses.glossZh: 安全的；没有危险或受伤害风险的
sourceExamples: a safe trip
you will be safe here
a safe place
a safe bet

senses.definitionEn: (of an undertaking) secure from risk
senses.glossZh: （事业或行动）没有风险的；稳妥的

senses.definitionEn: a state at a particular time
senses.glossZh: 某一时刻的状态；状况
sourceExamples: a condition (or state) of disrepair
the current status of the arms negotiations

senses.definitionEn: an assumption on which rests the validity or effect of something else
senses.glossZh: 使另一事物成立或生效的前提；条件

senses.definitionEn: (usually plural) a statement of what is required as part of an agreement
senses.glossZh: （通常用复数）协议规定的要求；条款
sourceExamples: the contract set out the conditions of the lease
the terms of the treaty were generous

senses.definitionEn: a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to
senses.glossZh: 按时间组织的工作或事项计划

senses.definitionEn: an ordered list of times at which things are planned to occur
senses.glossZh: 预定事项的时间表
